ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Bodged
ModMetaData.author: Zapdude
ModMetaData.description: Important: This mod must be placed right below Core/Expansions and above Multiplayer Bodge Jobs to work correctly. RimWorld 1.7 requires Harmony 3\n This is a fork of Multiplayer including upstream PRs targeting desyncs and connection issues, alongside fixes written by me to fix errors I've personally encountered. Full list of changes over Multiplayer 0.11.5 can be found in About/changelog.md. I will not link to MP's Discord/FAQ because any reports due to using this fork shouldn't go to them. Should be obvious but this fork wouldn't exist without years of hard work from 60+ contributors. It is temporary and for personal use.
